verdict.rationale: The Entity Management API docs include an OpenAPI Specification File section with a downloadable spec, which directly delivers the story. The probe found nothing at well-known paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json), but the docs never claim those paths exist, so this does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: evidence of OpenAPI specs for the other SAM.gov APIs (Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy, Assistance Listings), a stable well-known spec URL, and hands-on confirmation that the spec file downloads and is valid.
